records.text: Minneapolis Lakers won the 1953 NBA Finals, beating the New York Knicks 4 games to 1 with a 91–84 win in Game 5 at Madison Square Garden, New York City. It was their 4th title. They had finished the regular season 48–22.
records.textJa: Minneapolis Lakersが1953年のNBAファイナルでNew York Knicksに4勝1敗で勝った（第5戦は91対84）（Madison Square Garden、New York City）。通算4度目の優勝。レギュラーシーズンの成績は48–22。

records.text: Syracuse Nationals won the 1955 NBA Finals, beating the Fort Wayne Pistons 4 games to 3 with a 92–91 win in Game 7 at Oncenter War Memorial Arena, Syracuse. It was their 1st title. They had finished the regular season 43–29.
records.textJa: Syracuse Nationalsが1955年のNBAファイナルでFort Wayne Pistonsに4勝3敗で勝った（第7戦は92対91）（Oncenter War Memorial Arena、Syracuse）。通算1度目の優勝。レギュラーシーズンの成績は43–29。
